sections.heading: Render lane — grey car chassis, defect (a): FIXED 2026-09-30

fields.label: Root cause
fields.value: LoadCar and LoadCarLiveries handed the WHOLE vehicle clump to the wheel heuristic, BuildDffBatches and RaceSubmit_RegisterModel, so the standalone drew all 71 of ADVANTAGE0.DFF's atomics. 27 are not body geometry: 4 coarse untextured car-sized collision hulls (40/44/56/60 tris, material (102,102,102)) and 23 one-triangle locator quads. They covered the painted body with a faceted grey shell and ringed it with dark spikes.

fields.label: Fix
fields.value: CarDropNonRenderAtomics erases every batch with (geo_flags & 0x84) == 0 right after model.Parse in both loaders, so ONE filtered model feeds all three consumers. model.bbox deliberately NOT recomputed (it feeds car_ground_off_ / car_len_ / car_height_). Commit 5ddc0384. rva-lint allowlisted=122 NEW=0.

fields.label: NOT a verbatim port — recorded as such
fields.value: The original scatters atomics into DAT_0063d9e0 + player*0x2AC by the PART CODE from FUN_004b5190 @ 0x004b5190 (FUN_00420420 @ 0x00420420), and the four hulls (codes 0x3b..0x3e) go to the BVH build at FUN_0053d400 @ 0x0053d400. That part code is not derivable from the DFF — OPEN row U-9079 — so this is a MEASURED data-driven equivalent. No hooks.csv row, no C-level.

sections.heading: Render lane — car brightness, defect (d): FIXED 2026-09-30

fields.label: Root cause
fields.value: ParseLightsDffFaithful composed the track directional light's world at-vector ONE FRAME TOO MANY — it seeds from rot[6..8], already the parent-space at-axis, then walked from the light's own frame. Wrong sun on 13 of 13 shipped tracks. The original computes no direction at all (FUN_00479330 @ 0x00479330 adds the LIGHTS.DFF lights with RpWorldAddLight as-is).

fields.label: Fix
fields.value: TrackRenderer.cpp:853 + twin :751 — parent-start the frame-chain walk. One token each. Both renderers read the same sun_dir_ (RwRaceSubmit.cpp:571), so one change covers librw and the legacy D3D9 path. No RVA, no hooks.csv row. rva-lint allowlisted=122 NEW=0.
